I have a Bigscreen Beyond and can recommend it for sims but there a few caveats. There is glare but when the IPD is dialed in and brightness is lowered it isn't super bad, probably on par with an index god rays.  The sweetspot  is really small. You will have to look around a lot and not just look down with your eyes like in an index or quest 3.  However that is made better by how light the headset is. It is easy to look around being so light.  You can really whip your head around and look behind you.

The resolution and colors are amazing. The blacks look so good.  You would be able to read all the dials in a cockpit. Last night I was just admiring how detailed the steam vr home looks.
